start: Owner in Settings on an online gym whose server has Bring a friend

steps.action: Scroll to the card "Bring a friend"
user_sees: "Members can send a friend a link from the MettleUp app. The friend leaves a name and number, and it shows in Enquiries with the member’s name."
Box "Free days for each friend who joins" (empty reads "None")
Hint "Type how many free days a member gets, with one tap from you, for each friend who joins through their invite link, or leave it empty to give none."
"Friends who left their number: {n} · Friends who joined: {n}"
must_not: The card on a gym that is not online

user_sees: A toast "Saved. A member gets 7 free days for each friend who joins."
The box keeps 7; the button is greyed again
must_not: The toast shows but the number is not saved
Free days added to any member at this moment (they are added only by the owner's tap on a joined friend)

start: Owner in Settings, card "Bring a friend"

user_sees: Under the box: "Type a whole number of days from 1 to 60, or leave it empty."

steps.action: Type "ten", then "1.5", and tap "Save free days" each time
user_sees: The same line under the box
must_not: A wrong number saved as 1 or 0

steps.action: Open Settings on a gym that is not online, or whose server does not have Bring a friend
user_sees: No "Bring a friend" card at all
must_not: A card whose Save fails every time

start: Owner in Settings, card "Bring a friend", 7 free days saved

steps.action: Look at the button without changing the box
Empty the box (or type 0) and tap "Save free days"
user_sees: A toast "Saved. No free days for a friend who joins."
must_not: Members still told they get 7 days

user_sees: A toast "Saved. A member gets 1 free day for each friend who joins."

start: Owner in Settings, card "Bring a friend", after a member invited two friends

user_sees: Only two numbers: friends who left their number and friends who joined
must_not: A friend's name or number on this card
Friends who went to another gym counted here

steps.action: Open the member app of a member of this gym after saving 7 days
user_sees: The app tells the member their gym can add 7 free days when a friend joins
must_not: The app promising days the gym set to none
Days added to the member without the owner's tap
